curation_manifest.description: 64 Tsuboyama records extracted in original order from the pre-outcome public-data-derived pair manifest; public assay metadata, sequences, variants and observed scores only. private in the old filename meant withheld from agents, not private data.
curation_manifest.selection: Original pairs chosen by per-assay seeded PRNG, rank gap >=0.5 and score margin >=IQR; successor rejoins raw data and excludes seven raw/processed discrepancies. No model outcomes used.
